title: Tambuli Supreme upo: Characteristics
metaDescription: Tambuli Supreme upo is an upo variety from Ramgo. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Tambuli Supreme is an upo variety, also sold or known as Ramgo Tambuli Supreme. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: Ampalaya seedlings planted through plastic mulch on raised beds, the kind of farm where Tambuli Supreme upo is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Ramgo Tambuli Supreme, this is the same upo. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [upo variety finder](/crop-varieties/upo), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for gourds and melons](/land-preparation/cucurbit-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit upo fields most often: [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [melon fly](/pests/melon-fly), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [squash beetle](/pests/squash-beetle). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 40 to 45 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Bright green cylinder with a marked neck and flat blossom end, 28 to 30 cm long.
Tolerant to bacterial wilt and fusarium wilt.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: ramgo's professional upo, carrying the familiar Tambuli name, only evidence is Ramgo's own listing. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual upo on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Tambuli Supreme upo

Upo grows fast on a trellis. Pick a variety with a smooth, even fruit that stays tender, and harvest it young. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Ramgo Tambuli Supreme the same as Tambuli Supreme?
items.a: Yes. Ramgo Tambuli Supreme is another name for Tambuli Supreme. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tambuli Supreme?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
